findings.evidence: T036 is explicitly an authenticated recovery/resume API RED covering 401/403/ownership nondisclosure and the public Chinese manual-resume action. The exact map pairs it with T037, but T037 explicitly edits only PreparedPass1Coordinator.cs and PreparedPass1Store.cs and leaves the endpoint, DTO, validator, registration, and shared public paths to T045. T045 is the first task that can create POST /api/pass1-executions/{pass1ExecutionId}/resume, yet its paired T044 RED names Start, PATCH concurrency, GET Status, and only a recovery-compatible surface rather than the complete Resume endpoint behavior. Therefore T037 cannot make T036 green, and implementation can either claim a false GREEN checkpoint or implement the public endpoint outside T037's write boundary. This contradicts plan.md Public-Seam Test-First Slice 9 and the task-set rule that every behavioral GREEN has an observed public-seam RED with exact sole ownership.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks so coordinator/store recovery behavior has its own pre-production RED paired to T037, while the complete authenticated POST Resume endpoint assertions are explicitly owned by T044 or another RED paired to T045. Alternatively move the complete endpoint/DTO/validator/registration ownership into the GREEN paired with T036, but then serialize and remove the duplicate T045 ownership. Update Phase 6/8 independent-test text, dependency order, ownership map, exact RED/GREEN map, and traceability so every intermediate GREEN checkpoint compiles and its named public-seam suite passes.
